daily.brief: 過去約30小時（11月22日凌晨至23日上午）145個帳號發了483則帖。共同看好集中在$AMZN、$GOOGL同$META，有人睇相對強度同入場區；共同看淡則是$SOXL同$ARKK。最熱鬧的$NVDA提及138次，多空帳號18對14，圍繞財報後算力是否真正利用同過度建設爭論。VIX觸及40附近成為最大變化。
daily.full:
共識

共同看好以大型科技為主。$AMZN有3個帳號同向：@OptionsMike指出再次顯示相對強度，仍在6個月通道內並守住200日均線（原帖）；@jasonschips提到亞馬遜接近以75億美元收購Decart獲取AI軟件優化人才（原帖）。$GOOGL同$META也各有3個帳號看好。@DougKass在弱勢中增加淨多頭，買入SPY、QQQ、MSFT、GOOGL、META等（原帖）；@OptionsMike睇$META 540-520區域作入場（原帖）；@MrMikeInvesting則以VIX觸及40+、Cramer轉空作逆向買入訊號，並點名GOOGL（原帖）。@JasonL_Capital強調成長股估值已變便宜，NVDA遠期只剩8倍（原帖）。

共同看淡

$SOXL同$ARKK各有2個帳號看淡。@KobeissiLetter報告3倍槓桿半導體ETF $SOXL從6月高點下跌90%，至2025年9月以來最低（原帖）；@Mr_Derivatives則指年度蠟燭圖上影線極長（原帖）。@JonkooTrades批評Cathie Wood買在最熱IPO同AI名稱頂部，包括$NVDA 9月29日227美元買入後已跌44.8%（原帖）。

分歧

分歧最大的是$NVDA，138則提及中多空帳號18對14。@StockSavvyShay在財報後仍未見AI過度建設跡象，算力完全利用，Hopper GPU重新簽約約為原價2倍，雲端積壓訂單再增5000億美元（原帖）；但有人仍擔心回撤。@Beth_Kindig引述美光CEO稱2027同2028年將比2026更緊張，2027年75%已售罄（原帖）。$QQQ多空11對2，$TSLA 7對3。@OptionsMike指$TSLA守住345，收盤340同樣，8月低點仍有距離（原帖）。$ANT從86美元反彈獲注意，但多空3對2。

其他值得留意

@Micro2Macr0引述Dr. Ed Yardeni預期回調已變成修正，但不致熊市，看$SPX 2027年底介於8500同9000（原帖）。@TheTranscript_提到$MSFT CEO Nadella稱Agent 365已有5000萬個代理（原帖）。整體多頭觀點237，空頭73，清晰表態帳號83個。

daily.brief: Over roughly the last 30 hours (early Nov 22 to morning of Nov 23), 145 accounts posted 483 times. Shared bullish views concentrated on $AMZN, $GOOGL and $META, with comments on relative strength and entry zones; shared bearish focused on $SOXL and $ARKK. The busiest name $NVDA had 138 mentions with 18 bullish versus 14 bearish accounts, debating post-earnings compute utilization versus overbuilding. VIX near 40 was the largest shift.
daily.full:
Consensus

Shared bullish views centered on large-cap tech. $AMZN had 3 accounts aligned: @OptionsMike noted renewed relative strength, still inside the 6-month channel and holding the 200-day MA (post); @jasonschips mentioned Amazon nearing a $7.5B acquisition of Decart for AI software optimization talent (post). $GOOGL and $META each had 3 bullish accounts. @DougKass added to net long exposure on weakness, buying SPY, QQQ, MSFT, GOOGL, META and others (post); @OptionsMike is looking at the 540-520 zone on $META for entry (post); @MrMikeInvesting treated VIX at 40+ and Cramer turning bearish as a contrarian buy signal, naming GOOGL (post). @JasonL_Capital highlighted that growth stocks have become cheap, with NVDA now at 8x forward earnings (post).

Shared Bearish

$SOXL and $ARKK each had 2 bearish accounts. @KobeissiLetter reported the 3x leveraged semiconductor ETF $SOXL down 90% from its June high, at the lowest since September 2025 (post); @Mr_Derivatives noted the annual candle’s upper shadow is long enough to pick teeth with (post). @JonkooTrades criticized Cathie Wood for buying the hottest IPOs and AI names at the top, including $NVDA purchased at $227 on September 29 and now down 44.8% (post).

Split

The largest split was on $NVDA, with 18 bullish versus 14 bearish accounts among 138 mentions. @StockSavvyShay still saw no signs of AI overbuilding after earnings, compute fully utilized, Hopper GPUs being re-signed at roughly 2x original price, and cloud backlog adding another $500B (post); others remained wary of the drawdown. @Beth_Kindig quoted Micron’s CEO that 2027 and 2028 will be tighter than 2026, with 75% of 2027 already sold out (post). $QQQ was 11 versus 2, $TSLA 7 versus 3. @OptionsMike said $TSLA is holding 345, closed 340 the same, still some distance from the August low (post). $ANT bounced from $86 and drew attention, split 3 versus 2.

Other Notable

@Micro2Macr0 quoted Dr. Ed Yardeni expecting the pullback has become a correction but not a bear market, targeting $SPX between 8500 and 9000 by end-2027 (post). @TheTranscript_ noted $MSFT CEO Nadella saying Agent 365 already has 50 million agents (post). Overall 237 bullish views, 73 bearish, 83 clear accounts.
